description: This file is a shell script for log file management, including backup, movement, and cleanup of various log files specific to different hardware configurations and system states.

methods.name: moveFile
methods.description: Moves a file to a new location if it exists.

methods.name: moveFiles
methods.description: Moves multiple files matching a pattern from one directory to another.

methods.name: backup
methods.description: Backs up various system logs and files from a source directory to a destination based on provided options, handling different device configurations.

methods.name: crashLogsBackup
methods.description: Backs up crash logs matching specific filename patterns.

methods.name: backupAppBackupLogFiles
methods.description: Backs up application backup logs, images, and system logs, considering different device types and configurations.

methods.name: backupSystemLogFiles
methods.description: Backs up system log files such as startup logs, debug logs, and other system-specific logs.

methods.name: logCleanup
methods.description: Logs the completion of log backup process.
